name: Generic S-band airport surveillance radar
notes: Constant or staggered PRI, 12-15 rpm mechanical scan, typical PRF 700-1200 Hz. Civil ATC primary radar.

name: Generic X-band marine navigation radar
notes: Magnetron, short pulse, high PRF, 20-45 rpm; extremely common civilian emitter near 9410 MHz.

name: Generic S-band marine radar
notes: Long-range marine radar, better rain penetration than X-band.

name: L-band ATC secondary radar (SSR / IFF)
notes: 1030 MHz interrogation, 1090 MHz reply; Mode S replies are pulse-position modulated, appear as OOK.

name: ADS-B extended squitter
notes: 112-bit Mode S messages at 1 Mbit/s broadcast by aircraft transponders.

name: C-band weather radar
notes: Jittered or dual PRF to resolve range/velocity ambiguity; slow volume scan.

name: X-band precision approach radar
notes: Sector scan in azimuth and elevation near runways.

name: VHF marine voice channel
notes: 25 kHz channels; channel 16 at 156.800 MHz is distress and calling; channel 70 at 156.525 MHz is DSC data.

name: AIS transponder
notes: 9600 bit/s GMSK, ship position reports on AIS1/AIS2.

name: Airband voice
notes: AM voice, 25 kHz or 8.33 kHz spacing; 121.5 MHz is the emergency frequency.

name: Military UHF airband voice
notes: AM voice; 243.0 MHz guard frequency.

name: COSPAS-SARSAT distress beacon
notes: EPIRB/ELT/PLB, 5 W bursts every 50 s, 121.5 MHz homing.

name: TETRA base station
notes: pi/4-DQPSK, 25 kHz channels, public safety trunked radio (Europe).

name: PMR446 handheld
notes: Licence-free 0.5 W FM handhelds, 16 channels.

name: FM broadcast
notes: Wideband FM, 75 kHz deviation, stereo multiplex.

name: GPS L1
notes: C/A code 1.023 Mchip/s BPSK spread spectrum, below the noise floor at the antenna.

name: Wi-Fi / drone link 2.4 GHz
notes: ISM band: Wi-Fi OFDM (QPSK/QAM subcarriers), Bluetooth GFSK, drone control links with frequency hopping.

name: Wi-Fi / drone video 5.8 GHz
notes: ISM band: Wi-Fi and analogue/digital drone video.

name: LTE / 5G NR base station
notes: Cellular downlink; sub-bands 700-960 MHz, 1.7-2.7 GHz, 3.4-3.8 GHz.

name: DVB-T television
notes: 8 MHz channels, COFDM with QAM subcarriers.

name: VOR / ILS localiser
notes: Continuous AM-modulated beacon; ILS localiser 108-112 MHz, glide path 328-335 MHz.

name: DME / TACAN
notes: Pulse pairs 12 microseconds apart (X channels); PRI is jittered.

name: NAVTEX
notes: 518 kHz maritime safety information, 100 baud FSK.

name: Amateur 2 m FM
notes: Amateur radio; FM voice and packet.
